en_title: Marvel 1943: Rise of Hydra Is Reportedly 'Close to Done,' Though at the Cost of Cutting Back on Content and Length
cn_title: 据报道，《《漫威1943》: Rise of Hydra》「接近完成」，但代价是缩减内容和游戏时长
opus_summary: Kotaku报道称，《漫威1943：Rise of Hydra》已接近完成，但项目据称严重超出预算，内容和时长较最初设想大幅缩减。Kotaku与彭博社的Jason Schreier称，Skydancer管理层否认了游戏取消的传闻，并要求员工照常工作。目前游戏的发售时间尚不明确。

paragraphs.en: Marvel 1943: Rise of Hydra, Amy Hennig's Captain America/Black Panther game, is reportedly close to being finished, but it could be extremely compromised.
paragraphs.cn: 据报道，Amy Hennig的美国队长和黑豹游戏《《漫威1943》: Rise of Hydra》接近完成，但它可能做出了极大的妥协。

paragraphs.en: According to a new report from Kotaku , Marvel 1943: Rise of Hydra is "close to done." The news comes hours after rumors began spread online that the game was canceled, with an official announcement coming soon. According to Kotaku and Bloomberg's Jason Schreier, Skydancer leadership told staff via Slack that this is not the case and that they should continue business as usual.
paragraphs.cn: 根据Kotaku的一篇新报道，《《漫威1943》: Rise of Hydra》「接近完成」。几小时前，网上开始流传传闻，称这款游戏已被取消，官方公告即将发布。据Kotaku和彭博社的Jason Schreier称，Skydancer管理层通过Slack告诉员工，情况并非如此，他们应该照常工作。

paragraphs.en: Kotaku's report went on to describe the game's development as difficult, which should come as no surprise to anyone who's been following its journey. The title was announced in 2024 and has been delayed several times, with little to no news or footage beyond that.
paragraphs.cn: Kotaku的报道接着称这款游戏的开发过程艰难，对于一直关注其进展的人来说，这应该并不意外。这款游戏于2024年公布，此后多次延期，除此之外几乎没有任何消息或画面。

paragraphs.en: Kotaku claims that Marvel 1943: Rise of Hydra initially began as a Netflix game, but was later expanded for consoles and PC. Unfortunately, the title is reportedly "light on gameplay," with most of the action mapped to one button and the experience lacking "significant interactivity."
paragraphs.cn: Kotaku称，《《漫威1943》: Rise of Hydra》最初是一款Netflix游戏，但后来扩展至主机和PC。遗憾的是，据报道，这款游戏「玩法内容较少」，大多数动作都被映射到一个按键上，游戏体验缺乏「足够的互动性」。

paragraphs.en: The project has also allegedly gone well over budget, and as a result, has had to "significantly" scale back from its original vision in terms of content and length. As of right now, we have no idea when Marvel 1943: Rise of Hydra will release, but if it really is nearing the finish line, we could see something next year. Unfortunately, it doesn't seem like the game will be a hyper-engaging action/adventure title with riveting action, from the sound of it.
paragraphs.cn: 据称，该项目也已严重超出预算，因此不得不在内容和时长方面较最初的构想「大幅」缩减。截至目前，我们不知道《《漫威1943》: Rise of Hydra》何时发售，但如果它真的接近完成，我们明年或许能看到一些东西。遗憾的是，听起来这款游戏似乎不会是一部极具吸引力、动作场面扣人心弦的动作冒险作品。

paragraphs.en: This is purely speculative, but based on the details from Kotaku's report, it wouldn't be surprising if this is more along the lines of a Quantic Dream experience like Heavy Rain or Detroit: Become Human, with some combat sprinkled in. Either way, if fans were hoping for something like Marvel's Spider-Man, but with Captain America and Black Panther, they may end up pretty disappointed.
paragraphs.cn: 这纯属猜测，但根据Kotaku报道中的细节，如果这款游戏更接近Quantic Dream的《暴雨》或《底特律：变人》那样的体验，只穿插一些战斗，也不会令人意外。无论如何，如果粉丝期待的是类似《漫威蜘蛛侠》、但主角换成美国队长和黑豹的游戏，他们最终可能会相当失望。

paragraphs.en: Marvel 1943: Rise of Hydra is meant to be director Amy Hennig's first proper game since Uncharted 3 in 2011. Although she has consulted and helped out on some other games like Forspoken over the years, Hennig hasn't led a new game since Uncharted 3. She was reportedly ousted from Naughty Dog in the early 2010s after Uncharted 4 was struggling to meet internal expectations. She then went to EA, where she was meant to lead a new Star Wars game with Visceral Games, but the studio was shut down and the project was scrapped. Now, she's heading up this Marvel game... and we'll just have to wait and see how it turns out.
paragraphs.cn: 《《漫威1943》: Rise of Hydra》原本将是导演Amy Hennig自2011年的《神秘海域3》以来首款真正由她负责的游戏。尽管多年来她曾为《Forspoken》等其他一些游戏提供咨询和帮助，但Hennig自《神秘海域3》之后就没有主导过新游戏。据报道，在《神秘海域4》难以达到内部预期后，她于2010年代初被逐出顽皮狗。随后她去了EA，原本将在那里与Visceral Games共同主导一款新的《星球大战》游戏，但工作室被关闭，项目也被取消。现在，她正在负责这款漫威游戏……我们只能拭目以待，看看结果如何。
